scope: Live XiaoYu private plugin lifecycle fault injection

details: Stopping only xiaoyu_interaction_policy through the native plugin HTTP lifecycle left proactive_controller, qq_auto_reply and web_search running.
The existing reconcile_neko_plugin_runtime.py restarted only the missing plugin; the other three were reported already_running.
Autostart admission remained unchanged and passed after recovery.
The private plugin process was force-terminated at the process level.
N.E.K.O reported the plugin stopped within about one second.
After seven seconds no replacement child process appeared and plugin status remained stopped.
A later invocation of the existing native reconcile helper restored only the missing plugin.

degraded_features: semantic owner-control observation handled by the private plugin while it is down
ActivityWatch recent-activity query entry while it is down
shadow-only interruptibility capability observation while it is down

decision.reason: The failure is visible and recoverable through the existing N.E.K.O lifecycle API/reconcile path, while critical identity/memory/delivery safety remains outside this plugin. A permanent XiaoYu watchdog would duplicate lifecycle ownership and could incorrectly restart an intentionally stopped plugin.
decision.preferred_future: Reuse a native N.E.K.O crash-restart policy or lifecycle extension point if upstream adds one.
